{{Top|leg}}
A '''bootlegger turn''' was a flight maneuver that could be performed in [[Airspeeder/Legends|airspeeders]] and [[Landspeeder/Legends|landspeeders]]. Drivers piloting the vehicle would slam on the brakes, spinning the vehicle one-hundred and eighty degrees while sliding to the side. A properly executed bootlegger turn would leave the vehicle traveling in the opposite direction.
